components.name: Name

IDEAL.name: Ideal (Raoult's law)
IDEAL.hint: Ideal gas and ideal liquid. Low pressure, similar molecules (e.g. benzene–toluene).

PR.name: Peng–Robinson
PR.hint: Cubic equation of state. Hydrocarbons and light gases, also at high pressure.

SRK.name: Soave–Redlich–Kwong
SRK.hint: Cubic equation of state, similar to Peng–Robinson.

NRTL.name: NRTL
NRTL.hint: Activity coefficients for polar, non-ideal liquids. Coming after the demo.

thermo.binary_need_two: Add at least two components to see their binary parameters.
thermo.binary_not_needed: Raoult's law uses no binary parameters.
thermo.binary_waiting: The database values appear when the engine has loaded.
thermo.missing_note: Pairs without a value use k_ij = 0. Check results for these pairs or enter a value from the literature.
thermo.database_note: Database: ChemSep Peng–Robinson table, shipped with thermo.

issues.engine_unavailable: The calculation engine ({{engine}}) is not available right now.
issues.fractions_not_normalized: {{target}}: mole fractions add up to {{sum}}, not 1.
issues.missing_binary_parameter: No binary parameter for {{i}}–{{j}}; using k_ij = 0.
issues.duplicate_id: Id "{{id}}" is used more than once.
issues.unknown_unit: {{target}}: connected to unit "{{unit}}", which does not exist.
issues.port_used_twice: {{target}}: port "{{port}}" has more than one stream.
issues.layout_orphan: Canvas position stored for missing unit "{{unit}}".
issues.invalid_document: The file is not a valid OPD flowsheet ({{where}}: {{detail}}).
issues.unsupported_thermo: Property package {{package}} is not available in the {{engine}} engine yet.
issues.unsupported_unit: {{target}}: unit type "{{type}}" is not available in the {{engine}} engine yet.
issues.unknown_spec: {{target}}: "{{spec}}" is not a setting of this unit.
issues.split_needs_one_open_outlet: {{target}}: give a split fraction for every outlet except one.
issues.invalid_split: {{target}}: split fractions must be between 0 and 1 and add up to at most 1 (now {{sum}}).
issues.recycle_not_supported: {{target}}: is part of a recycle loop; recycle loops are not supported by the {{engine}} engine yet.
issues.unknown_component_data: No property data found for a component ({{detail}}).
